title: Invoice location
passage: Where did you put the original invoice? A. The total looks correct. B. We originally planned to pay cash. C. I gave it to Priya in accounting.
passageZh:
你把發票正本放在哪裡？
A. 總額看起來正確。
B. 我們原本打算付現金。
C. 我交給會計部的 Priya 了。
audioScript: Where did you put the original invoice? A. The total looks correct. B. We originally planned to pay cash. C. I gave it to Priya in accounting.
